messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for gateway-prod (>8% over baseline) — hitting from eu-west-1. Auto-created incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0421 :rotating_light:

murali (oncall): saw the alert, looking. paging team now. any customer reports?

alice (sre): no incoming customer pings in #support yet, but Grafana shows 502/504 spikes starting ~02:12 UTC. tailing gateway logs now.

jamie (infra): copying logs, but spans/traces for these requests are sparse. traces are mostly missing request-id and have sampler dropped flag.

murali (oncall): important — if traces are sampled out we can't do root cause quickly. can someone check trace-sampler config?

nora (platform): checking the global tracing config. last deploy bumped sampler to 0.1% for prod because of cost. switching to 5% temporarily. patching config-map now.

devops-bot: executed: kubectl patch configmap observability-config -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/trace_sample_rate","value":"0.05"}]' — success.

jamie (infra): confirmed new config landed in prod pods that read the configmap. starting a rolling restart for gateway pods that cache sampler.

alice (sre): rolling restart in progress. command used: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway -n prod```

murali (oncall): quick customer-impact note: Query shows ~12% of requests from EU got 5xx in last 10m, median latency up ~300ms. Adding to incident page.

jamie (infra): after restart, traces increased but still missing for a subset — looks like some services are not propagating the x-request-id header.

alice (sre): can we hotpatch the ingress to force request-id propagation? we could add an envoy header add to ensure downstream services get x-request-id if absent.

nora (platform): I can apply a sidecar Envoy config change as a stopgap. patch-ready snippet: ```yaml
- name: add-request-id
  typed_config:
    '@type': type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.header_to_metadata.v3.Config
    request_headers:
      - header: x-request-id
        on_missing: ADD
```

devops-bot: Applied config to gateway-envoy sidecar in prod-1, prod-2, prod-3. no restart required for the sidecar patch.

jamie (infra): running smoke tests: ```curl -s -D - https://gateway.prod/api/health -H 'X-Request-Id: test-123' | head -n 15``` headers propagated end-to-end for test-123.

alice (sre): good. telemetry shows a drop in 5xx after the sidecar patch and sampler increase. 5xx now ~3.6% and trending down. still watching for errors coming from a small set of upstream services.

murali (oncall): recorded interim mitigation: increased trace sampling, added request-id propagation sidecar. next: identify upstream that returns 502s — possible retry interaction with kv-cache layer. assigning to jamie to trace offending service map.

jamie (infra): starting binary search by service — looking at 502s, most originate from model-router -> kvcache reads timed out. opening a short-lived flamegraph and increasing client timeout on kvcache to 1.2s temporarily.

alice (sre): note for timeline: created runbook checkpoint "instrumentation-bridge" with steps we did. also documenting why sampler was low (cost control) and suggested alert to prevent sampler drift during incidents.

nora (platform): adding automated guard: flip sampler auto-increase policy to trigger when 5xx% > 5 for 5m. sending PR for review.

murali (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in ~30m. if anything regresses assign to nora. summary to next oncall: what we changed (sampler 0.1%->5%, envoy sidecar request-id add, kvcache timeout bump), current status: 5xx down to 2.8%, traces now populated for ~80% of requests.

nora (platform): acknowledged, I'll take post-mitigation monitoring and the follow-up action items (permanent sampler policy, add request-id to library, root-cause on kvcache timeouts).

alice (sre): follow-ups tracked: #1 add unit test in model-router to guarantee x-request-id propagation, #2 revert/optimize kvcache timeouts after root cause, #3 re-evaluate sampling rate with observability team.

devops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 updated: status=mitigated, severity=partial; postmortem assigned to jamie.

murali (oncall): thanks team — good run. leaving notes on the incident channel and updating the customer comms template (no direct customer page needed yet). :white_check_mark:
